title: Define operator-facing artifact explanation format
purpose: Give operators a clear explanation of what an artifact is, what it changes, what it requires and why it may be blocked.
scope: Include trust tier, channel, dependencies, risk, activation requirements and replay status.
Exclude raw secrets and untrusted instructions.
acceptance_criteria: Operator can see added capabilities and policies.
Projection does not reveal raw secrets.
failure_modes: Explanation implies staged artifact is active.
Risk or trust tier is omitted.
Raw secret-like content appears in projection.
